purpose: Correct two overclaims from the 325l/327l/328l (MP) and 326l/329l/330l (RS/MS) rounds, then sequence the full path to an honest RS_pass/MP_pass/MS_pass and three external closures. No relabeled result may be read as a formal head pass or a formal head failure.

owner_cluster_violation.requirement_violated: panel population must be at most one state per owner (paper1_mp_rule_based_step1_v1.json#panel_v1_requirements.population; paper1_rs_ms_r0_delta_measurement_and_panel_revision_v2.json#panel_v2_requirements.population)

mp_panel.consequence: The reported '6 CONSTRAIN_eligible states, 5 field types' spans only 5 distinct owners, not 6; the '4 IGNORE states' span only 3 distinct owners, not 4. Every finding computed from this panel must be read at owner-cluster resolution, not state resolution.

rs_ms_panel_v2.consequence: The panel's 13 states span 12 distinct owners, not 13. This does not invalidate the two-distinct-owner CLEAR finding (evo::p1 and evo::p8 remain two distinct owners for the CLEAR verdict specifically), but the panel's general population claim was wrong and must not recur.

owner_cluster_violation.root_cause: Neither 325l nor 326l checked owner-uniqueness across the FULL curated set -- only within-stratum diversity was checked (e.g. 'N distinct field types among the CONSTRAIN_eligible states'), not across-stratum reuse of the same owner. This is the same class of error already corrected once this session for the MS-only ablation's clustered significance test; it recurred here because the check was never made a mechanical panel-build invariant.
owner_cluster_violation.required_fix_for_future_panels: Every future panel materializer must assert len({state['runtime_owner_key'] for state in all_curated_states}) == len(all_curated_states) before writing the panel report, not just per-stratum owner counts.

explicitly_not: evidence that MP as a head concept cannot work
a result that blocks a future, differently-designed MP panel
MP.reason: 0/6 CONSTRAIN_eligible cases (5 distinct owners after clustering) showed observable contribution, but a direct read of the M0+R0 replies shows none of them contained a concrete wording/timing/logistics slot for the MP fact to modify in the first place -- the replies were uniformly generic emotional validation with no proposed suggestion, schedule, or logistic detail. This means the panel could not distinguish 'MP has no effect' from 'MP was never given a modifiable target' -- the treatment interface (raw field-scope trigger against an unconstrained R0 reply) is the more likely culprit than the MP concept itself. See root_fix_mp below for the corrected interface design.

explicitly_not: evidence sufficient to proceed directly to formal external qualification
MS.reason: Only the Function observability sub-gate was checked (2/5 CLEAR_USE cases CLEAR from 2 distinct owners after clustering). Quality, Risk, and same_stack_outcome -- three of the four head_pass_definition sub-criteria -- were not measured in this round. A positive Function subgate is necessary but not sufficient for development_promotion, let alone MS_pass.

step_2_5_v2_manifest_and_frozen_gate.result: rs_pass_this_round=true (not yet formally confirmed, see step_2_6 -- RS calls also used current_user_text only). ms_pass_this_round was initially computed false (ms_risk failed on evo::p18/evo::p8), but step_2_6 found this was a context-truncation measurement bug, not a real MS failure -- see corrected status there. interaction_pass_this_round=false remains valid and unaffected: ms_rs_combined_risk failed critically on evo::p6, a topical-mismatch negative control that leaked sensitive irrelevant content once RS also fired, confirmed independent of the truncation bug.

step_2_6_context_truncation_correction.scope: All 101-call Quality/Risk/Function calls, and the panel's own CLEAR_USE curation, used only current_user_text instead of the full visible_current_session_dialogue. evo::p18 (California offer) and evo::p8 (Emily) both had their 'unsupported'/'CLEAR' content already stated earlier in the same session -- neither the risk flag nor the Function label can be trusted. evo::p6's leak is unaffected (verified: nothing related appears anywhere in its full session) and remains a confirmed MS+RS composition failure. MS status corrected to CONTEXT_TRUNCATED_MEASUREMENT_INCONCLUSIVE, explicitly not a formal failure.
step_2_6_context_truncation_correction.forward_policy: Every future generator/selector/Quality/Risk/Function call must use the full visible_current_session_dialogue. Function CLEAR/PLAUSIBLE requires confirming content is not recoverable from the FULL session, not just the latest turn.

step_3_root_fix_mp.operationalization: Zero-API panel curation selects CONSTRAIN candidates only where the query text plausibly invites a concrete suggestion/logistics/scheduling response (a full generation-time R0-plan-freeze architecture was out of scope for a zero-API round). gender/nationality excluded (default IGNORE); age excluded (no genuine life-stage-constraint example found this pass).
step_3_root_fix_mp.honest_scope: 5 CONSTRAIN states (job x4, education x1), short of the original >=6/3-field target -- location field yielded no genuine concrete-slot candidates in this corpus on manual review.

step_3_ms_root_fix.scope: Root-fixes both bugs from the 101-call closeout: full visible_current_session_dialogue used throughout (curation and compilation), and MS USE/ASK/IGNORE pre-decided before compilation (v1_5_ms_pre_decision.py) so IGNORE sources are physically absent from every arm including MS+RS. The exact evo::p6 leaked source is reused verbatim on a fresh state as a live regression probe.
step_3_ms_root_fix.honest_scope: 1 ASK case, no dedicated stale/conflict case found this pass -- disclosed, not fabricated.

step_4_selector_honesty.scope: The scale-stable opportunity heads are not formal selectors. MP and MS are not promoted. ME's 97.1% ON rate is degenerate, not qualified. Refreeze a low-capacity selector per component that is grouped/cross-fitted, holds out an untouched confirmation split, beats prevalence and transparent-rule baselines, transports non-degenerately externally (not 0% or near-always-on), and never reads external outcomes to tune its threshold.

step_5_formal_chain.scope: Only after all three head treatments AND their selectors pass development gates: ESConv (RS vs always-off/fixed-high/rule/cost-and-ON-rate-matched-random), EvoEmo (RS/MP/MS individually, jointly, and full-minus-component vs every fixed/rule/random/cost-matched/oracle baseline), ES-MemEval (no-memory/full-history/official-RAG-Top4/typed-fixed-high/learned-PM, reporting MP and MS marginal contribution separately). Each track clustered by dialogue or user; no cross-task pooling.

step_6_me_bounded_rescue.scope: Zero-API only: repair compiler-valid candidate eligibility prefiltering and measure the natural ON-rate. Only if a non-degenerate selector results does a small Function panel follow; otherwise ME stays LIMITED_SURFACE/SELECTOR_SUPPORT, fixed OFF, and does not block the RS+MP+MS main line.

forbidden_reinterpretations: MS's FUNCTION_SUBGATE_POSITIVE is not MS_pass or full development_promotion
MP's PANEL_TREATMENT_INTERFACE_INCONCLUSIVE is not a formal MP head failure and does not block a redesigned panel
reusing any development-panel result as external-track confirmatory evidence
post-hoc sample deletion or re-stratification after seeing generation outcomes
presenting a controlled-selector or development-panel score as an external track pass
changing a development or formal gate's threshold after seeing the result it would otherwise fail
treating any single-panel, small-n, first-party or even one independent-reviewer finding as sufficient for a formal head pass
